item.title: She Flew to Vietnam to Buy Pearls Cheap. She Quit Her Job to Stop It Instead | A Relaxing Story
item.description:
Laura Kessler had flown to Vietnam to put her signature on a deal that would save her company nine dollars a pearl, and she was about to spend the next year making sure that signature never happened.
Laura Kessler spent fourteen years sourcing gemstones for a US jewelry chain. Her company sent her to Duong Dong, Phu Quoc, to lock in a cheap bulk pearl deal that would have rushed the harvest and ruined the oysters. She met the widow keeping the farm alive, saw exactly what the deal would do to it, and quit rather than sign it. A complete, relaxing story about walking away from a good job to help build a better one, on the real river town of Duong Dong, Phu Quoc, Vietnam. Names, characters, and the pearl farm are fictional.
